title: The page index of the site (kb-index/1)
description: Every page the site built, in one JSON document served as index.json, contract kb-index/1. Read it to find a page and what sits beside it: a page of the knowledge base names its record (kb-record/1), the typed JSON copy of the page, and every page that has a markdown source names that too. The index lists the pages and carries no page text. Every key is always there, except `markdown` on a page that has no markdown source. Keys come in the order this file lists them, and the document is two-space JSON with one newline at the end, so two builds of the same pages are byte for byte equal. Adding a key stays in kb-index/1, so ignore keys you do not know; renaming, removing or retyping a key, or changing an order, would be kb-index/2, published beside this file. ORDER: `pages` has the home page first, then the pages by area in the order of the site's structure file, then by route. WHICH PAGES: every built page is listed. A page of the knowledge base has values in `id`, `kind`, `band`, `group` and `record`; every other page (a hub, the home page, a map, reference or concept page) holds null in those five keys. An address that the index does not list as a `record` has no record, and a request for it is not a 200.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, so a reader that holds the index can fetch what its keys mean.

contract.description: The contract and its major version: `kb-index/1`. A reader that knows only this one refuses any other value.

generator.description: The program that wrote the file: tools/src/site/site-portable.ts.

pages.description: Every built page, the home page first, then by area in structure order, then by route.

id.description: A page id: lower-case letters and digits in words joined by hyphens.

heading.description: One heading of a page, from the second level to the fourth.

depth.description: The heading level: 2 for an H2, 3 for an H3, 4 for an H4.

id.description: The id the heading's anchor carries, so `<route>#<id>` opens the page at it; '' when the heading has none.

text.description: The words of the heading, markup removed.

route.description: The page's address on the site, from the site root: a slash, its path and .html.

title.description: The page title: the headline of its structured data, else its title element.

description.description: The one-line description from the page's head; '' when it has none.

area.description: The id of the area the page is filed under in the site's structure.

status.description: The page's status, such as stable.

tags.description: The page's tags, in the order its head lists them; [] when it has none.

aliases.description: Other names the page goes by, in the order its head lists them; [] when it has none.

solves.description: The problems the page solves, each in the words of someone who has it; [] when it lists none.

id.description: For a page of the knowledge base, its id: its file name without .md, which every kb.mjs command takes. Null on any other page.

kind.description: For a page of the knowledge base, its kind, from the folder it sits in under docs/. Null on any other page.

band.description: For a pattern, the area directly under patterns; for any other page of the knowledge base, the kind itself. Null on any other page.

group.description: For a pattern, the area that lists it; for any other page of the knowledge base, the kind itself. Null on any other page.

record.description: For a page of the knowledge base, the address of its kb-record/1 record: `route` with .json in place of .html. Null on any other page, which has none.

headings.description: The page's headings from the second level to the fourth, in page order.

markdown.description: The address of the page's markdown source: `route` with .md in place of .html, byte for byte the file under docs/ the page is built from. Absent on a page that has no markdown source.
